hydrostatics.notes: Claude/Opus 2026-09-25 (RaisedDeckData, export_raised_hydrostatics.py wrapping Astra's export_hull_hydrostatics.py on the raised kit's Midship_W1__Hull_Shell.fbx, deck_z=4.20). Table-match gate vs hull.middle.w1x.v1's table below Z 1.76: volume at 1.76 w1x 254.2866 U^3 vs w1xr 254.2866 U^3 (0.0% relative diff, gate <=0.5%); max sectional-area relative diff 0.0% (near x=5.938, a small-absolute-area bow-tip/stern-step interpolation-grid artifact after excluding bulkhead step-transition bands -- see docs/RAISED-DECK.md Data results). Both PASS the 0.5% gate. Integrated volume to 4.20: 431.1378 U^3.

lightship.rule: 13264.4 kg (hull.middle.w1x.v1 lightship) + 2950.8 kg (measured upper structure: deck 18.12 m^2 x 110 kg/m^2 = 1993.2 kg, plus topside walls 10.08 m^2 x 95 kg/m^2 = 957.6 kg) = 16215.2 kg. Deck area = the Hull_Shell's own flat top cap footprint at Z 4.2 (the structural deck), NOT the decorative UpperPlanks/PlankDetails trim mesh (its footprint is only 0.507 m^2, a small fraction of the deck plan -- it is plank-seam detailing over part of the deck, not the deck surface). Wall area excludes the deck-cap band (centroid z > shell z-max - 0.05) so it is not double counted. measured 2026-09-25 (RaisedDeckData, Blender --background, art-staging/modular-raised-middle-v1).

holdCells.source: w1x Midship_W1 holdCells (7) + round(0.7 x upperVol / 38.229): upperVol = this module's OWN W1xR hydrostatic table integrated to 4.20 minus to 1.76 (176.851 U^3, measured, not the sec-5 deck-waterplane x 2.44 estimate) -> round(0.7 x 176.851 / 38.229) = 3 -> 7 + 3 = 10.

berths.source: w1x Midship_W1 berths (5) + floor(0.3 x deckArea / 12.8 U^2): deckArea = measured W1xR deck-cap footprint (72.480 U^2, Blender) -> floor(0.3 x 72.480 / 12.8) = 1 -> 5 + 1 = 6.

gunSlots.source: Same designated pair W1-r2's middle uses (DeckSlot_1), moved outboard with the deck edge; both pass the assembler's clearance/passage check against the real cannon (ExpandedHullValidation). PLUS the new ['DeckSlot_0_-1', 'DeckSlot_0_1'] pair (upper deck, Z 4.20, spec sec 5): sockets/equipmentSlots already existed in the w1x source; provisional, assembler check pending.

capacity.rule: Seeded 2026-09-25 (RaisedDeckData): w1x module capacity + the raised deltas from docs/RAISED-DECK.md sec 5, using this module's own measured W1xR hydrostatic table and Blender deck footprint (not the sec-5 estimate numbers). PROVISIONAL, tune freely.

upperStructure.source: Blender measurement 2026-09-25 (RaisedDeckData, tools/blender/measure_raised_modules.py). centroidZU = mass-weighted: (deckMassKg*4.20 + wallMassKg*wallAreaCentroidZU) / massKg. Not read by ModuleDef yet (JsonUtility drops unknown fields on read) -- the C# half (sec 6, HullFormData mass/CoM) should add a matching field and read this.
